ValidationRule.description: Ensures that an agent can't update 'Have All Defects Been Rectified' if the Case is Closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = "KYC_QA", ISPICKVAL ( Status, "Closed" ), ISCHANGED ( Fraud_Defects_Rectified__c ), NOT(ISCHANGED ( Status ) ), NOT(ISCHANGED ( Sub_Status__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: KYC checks are completed and the case is closed, please re-open the case in-order to update the 'Have All Defects Been Rectified'.
